entities.summary: Tela Railroad Company, a political institution in Honduras during Banana Republic Era (1899–1960). Grew from United Fruit Honduras Operations and Marco Aurelio Soto. Led to the emergence of Great Banana Strike 1954 and Great Banana Strike of 1954.
